correctness.rationale: The 84 triples on 9 labelled points are exhaustively processed by least-point recursion; choosing lexicographically increasing lines, respecting point degree 3 and forbidding duplicate point pairs yields every valid unlabelled-line design exactly once. Independent C++ implementation traversed 1,690,154 states and counted 73,920 labelled designs, with t=27/29/30 strata 3360/30240/40320. The displayed three representatives have point automorphism orders 108/12/9 (9!/aut matches the three strata), proving exactly three isomorphism orbits, not merely partial samples. Each explicit 18-vertex Levi graph is connected; independent 17×17 reduced integer Laplacian Smith form and exact determinant agree: t=27 factors 2,6,6,18,18,54; t=29 factors 2,6,48,2160; t=30 factors 214,5778. Determinants match spanning tree counts and valuation factorizations. Because the full finite universe was exhausted this is a genuine bounded exact classification proof, not a finite extrapolation.
